companies.name: パインブリッジ・インベストメンツ

relations.text: 2025年12月30日に買収を完了した資産運用会社である
relations.text_en: A global asset manager whose acquisition MIM completed on December 30, 2025

source.label: MetLife 10-K(2025)
source.quote: On December 30, 2025, MIM completed the acquisition of PineBridge Investments (“PineBridge”), a global asset manager.

companies.name: ブライトハウス・ファイナンシャル

relations.text: 元子会社で、25億ドルの信用状の受益者になっている
relations.text_en: A former subsidiary and a beneficiary of $2.5 billion of letters of credit

source.label: MetLife 10-K(2025)
source.quote: At December 31, 2025, Brighthouse Financial, Inc. and its subsidiaries (“Brighthouse”), a former subsidiary of MetLife, Inc., is a beneficiary of $ 2.5 billion of letters of credit issued under this facility

companies.name: タルコット・レゾリューション・ライフ保険

relations.text: 変額年金契約などを出再する再保険契約を結んだ
relations.text_en: Entered into a reinsurance agreement to cede certain variable annuity contracts and rider reserves

source.label: MetLife 10-K(2025)
source.quote: In December 2025, the Company entered into a reinsurance agreement with Talcott Resolution Life Insurance Company to cede certain variable annuity contracts and rider reserves on a funds withheld basis.

companies.name: シャリオット・リインシュアランス

relations.text: 2025年に再保険契約を2件結んだ
relations.text_en: Entered into two reinsurance agreements in 2025

source.label: MetLife 10-K(2025)
source.quote: Also in 2025, the Company entered into two reinsurance agreements with Chariot Reinsurance, Ltd.
